title: Detour Delay Referrals to the Fare Review Team, Wayfare Rides
content:
**Rule.** On **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** the time a rider lost to a driver's detour is never compensated by support itself: on a trip whose fare was recalculated because the actual miles or minutes ran beyond the estimate without any rider route change, support refers the detour delay to the fare review team as a fare review against the fare charge, giving route inefficiency as its reason, at the detour delay referral amount.

A trip whose rider changed the route, whose fare stood at the upfront fare, or whose actual minutes did not run beyond the estimated minutes has no detour delay to refer.

## Which trips have a detour delay to refer

| Trip's records | Detour delay |
|---|---|
| Fare recalculated because actual miles or minutes ran beyond the estimate; no rider route change; actual minutes beyond the estimated minutes | referred by support to the fare review team as a fare review against the fare charge, reason route inefficiency |
| Rider changed the route | nothing to refer |
| Fare stood at the upfront fare | nothing to refer |
| Actual minutes not beyond the estimated minutes | nothing to refer |

The referral registers a review; it does not itself pay the rider or change any charge. Support does not compensate lost time by adjusting or refunding a charge.

## Referring the delay — `refer_detour_delay_review_b094ef4b`

**Capability.** Refers the time a rider lost to a driver's detour to the fare review team. One call registers one fare review request against the fare charge of a detoured trip, with the reason route inefficiency, in submitted status, for the amount given. It changes no charge and moves no money until the fare review team decides; the rider sees the request under the trip's help history.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `refer_detour_delay_review_b094ef4b` with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trip_id` | the trip reference number of the detoured trip, as returned by the trip lookup | identifier |
| `original_charge_id` | the charge reference number of the trip's fare charge the review is registered against, as returned by the trip charge lookup | identifier |
| `requested_amount` | the amount referred to the review team | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `fare_review_id` (reference number of the new fare review request), `trip_id`, `trip_charge_id` (the fare charge under review), `review_reason` (always `route_inefficiency`), `requested_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `review_status`. A `review_status` of "submitted" means the request is registered.
